title: Readable Interface Notes
description: Guidelines for keeping a boardroom-inspired interface comfortable for actual reading.
excerpt: Guidelines for keeping a boardroom-inspired interface comfortable for actual reading.
html:
High-contrast cyan text on black can look sharp in screenshots and still become tiring in a long article.

Practical Defaults

  • Body copy uses off-white text without glow.
  • Cyan and yellow stay in borders, labels, links, and small status elements.
  • Motion respects reduced-motion preferences.
  • Panels collapse into a normal reading stack on small screens.

Contrast check The theme should be tested on a real laptop display, not only in a design mockup.
